page.overview:
Who is Accident Devil?

The の|Jiko no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of accidents.

The Accident Devil appears as an amalgamation of twisted cars, jagged metal fragments, and mechanical wreckage, forming a chaotic and industrial mass. Its body is composed of sharp, uneven surfaces resembling the aftermath of violent crashes. Notably, a grotesque humanoid face with long hair is embedded near the lower portion of its form, evoking the imagery of victims trapped within wreckage.

The Accident Devil's personality is currently unknown.

Yoru summons the Accident Devil and transforms it into a "Chainsaw Whip". Yoru wields the whip to strike and overwhelm Pochita during their battle.
